lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Good morning. Ms. Sato, this is Mr. Mike Miller.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: How do you do? I am Mike Miller. I am from the United States of America. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: I am Sato Keiko. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Yes. Who is it?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: I am Santos from (apartment) 408.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Hello. I am Santos. How do you do? It is nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: The pleasure's mine.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Er, this is a little something...

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Oh, thank you. What is it?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: It's coffee. Please.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Excuse me. Where is the wine department?

lines.speaker: Sales clerk A
lines.text: It is in the first basement.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Excuse me. Could you show me that wine?

lines.speaker: Sales clerk B
lines.text: Certainly. Here you are.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Is this French wine?

lines.speaker: Sales clerk B
lines.text: No, it's Italian.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: How much is it?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Well, I'll take it.
Hello, this is Ishida of the 104 Service.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Could you tell me the phone number of the Yamato Art Museum, please?
The Yamato Art Museum? Certainly.

lines.speaker: Tape
lines.text: The number you are inquiring about is 0797-38-5432.

lines.speaker: Museum staff member
lines.text: Hello, Yamato Art Museum.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Excuse me. What are your opening hours?

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.text: We are open from nine to four.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Which day of the week are you closed?

lines.speaker: Staff
lines.text: We are closed on Mondays.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Thank you very much.

5.title: Does this train go to Koshien?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Excuse me. How much is it to Koshien?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It's 350 yen.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: 350 yen? Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Excuse me. What platform is it for Koshien?

lines.speaker: Station employee
lines.text: No. 5.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Excuse me. Does this train go to Koshien?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No, it doesn't. The next “local train” does.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: Mr. Miller.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: I'm going to enjoy cherry-blossom viewing with my friends tomorrow. Won't you join us, Mr. Miller?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: That sounds nice. Where will you go?

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: Osakajo-Koen.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: What time?

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: At ten o'clock. Let's meet at Osakajo-Koen Station.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: Sato
lines.text: Well, see you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Jose Santos
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Yamada Ichiro
lines.text: Hello. Please come in.

lines.speaker: Jose Santos
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Yamada Tomoko
lines.text: How about a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Maria Santos
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Yamada Tomoko
lines.text: Here you are.

lines.speaker: Maria Santos
lines.text: Thank you. This spoon is nice, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Yamada Tomoko
lines.text: Yes, it is. Someone in my company gave it to me. It's a souvenir of her trip to Europe.

lines.speaker: Yamada Ichiro
lines.text: Have you got accustomed to living in Japan, Maria?

lines.speaker: Maria Santos
lines.text: Yes, I have. I enjoy it every day.

lines.speaker: Yamada Ichiro
lines.text: Really? Mr. Santos, how is your work?

lines.speaker: Jose Santos
lines.text: Well, it's busy, but interesting.

lines.speaker: Yamada Tomoko
lines.text: Would you like another cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Maria Santos
lines.text: No, thank you.

lines.speaker: Jose Santos
lines.text: Oh, it's eight o'clock now. We must be going.

lines.speaker: Yamada Ichiro
lines.text: You must?

lines.speaker: Maria Santos
lines.text: Thank you for everything today.

lines.speaker: Yamada Tomoko
lines.text: Our pleasure. Please come again.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Hello. This is Miller.

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: It's you, Mr. Miller. Good evening. How are you?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Fine. Thank you. Well, Ms. Kimura. How would you like to go to a concert by Seiji Ozawa?

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: That sounds nice. When will it be?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: It's on Friday night of next week.

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: Friday? Friday's a bit difficult.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: So you can't come?

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: I have arranged to meet a friend on Friday night.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: You have. I'm sorry to hear that.

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: I am, too. Please invite me again some other time.

10.title: Do you have chili sauce in this store?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Excuse me. Where is Yunyu-ya Store?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yunyu-ya Store? You see that white building over there? The store is in that building.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: I see. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Excuse me, do you have chili sauce?

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: Yes. There is a spice corner on the right-hand side at the back. Chili sauce is on the second rack from the bottom.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: I see. Thanks.

11.title: Please send this by sea mail

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Nice weather, isn't it? Are you going out?

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: Yes, I am going to the post office.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Really? See you later.

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: See you.

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: I would like to send this by special delivery.

lines.speaker: Post office clerk
lines.text: Sure. To Australia? That's 370 yen.

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: And also this parcel.

lines.speaker: Post office clerk
lines.text: By sea mail or airmail?

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: How much is sea mail?

lines.speaker: Post office clerk
lines.text: 500 yen.

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: How long will it take?

lines.speaker: Post office clerk
lines.text: It will take about one month.

lines.speaker: Wang
lines.text: Well, please send it by sea mail.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Hello. (I'm home.)

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Hello. (Welcome home.)

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: This is a souvenir from Kyoto. How was the Gion Festival?

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Thank you. The Gion Festival is the most famous of all the festivals in Kyoto.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: It was very interesting. There were a lot of foreign visitors.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Did you take photos?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Yes, I took about a hundred photos.

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: Amazing!

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Yes. But it made me a bit tired.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Why, it's already twelve. Shall we go for lunch?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Where shall we go?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Let me see. Today I want to eat Japanese food.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Then, let's go to “Tsuru-ya.”

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: May I take your order?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: I'll have the tempura set lunch.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: I'll have the gyudon.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: One tempura set lunch and one gyudon. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: 1,680 yen altogether, sir.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Excuse me. Please charge us separately.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Right. 980 yen for the tempura set lunch, 700 yen for the gyudon.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: To Umeda, please.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Excuse me. Turn to the right at that traffic light.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.text: To the right?

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.text: Go straight?

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Yes, go straight. Stop in front of that flower shop.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.text: Yes. 1,800 yen, please.

lines.speaker: Karina
lines.text: Here you are.

lines.speaker: Driver
lines.text: That's 3,200 yen change. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Today's movie was good, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: Yes, it was. The father was particularly good, wasn't he?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Yes. I was reminded of my family.

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: Were you? Tell me about your family, Mr. Miller.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: I have my parents and an elder sister.

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: Where do they live?

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: My parents live near New York City. My sister is in London. How about your family, Ms. Kimura?

lines.speaker: Kimura
lines.text: There are three of us. My father works for a bank. My mother teaches English at a high school.

16.title: Tell me how to use this machine

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Excuse me. Could you tell me how to use this machine?

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: You want to make a withdrawal?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: Then, please push this button, first.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: Do you have a cash card?

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Yes, here it is.

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: Put it in here, and enter the code number.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: Next, enter the sum.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Fifty thousand yen. Five...

lines.speaker: Bank clerk
lines.text: Push this “Man” and “En.” And then push this “Kakunin” button.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Got it, thank you very much.

17.title: What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Matsumoto
lines.text: I have had a sore throat and a slight temperature since yesterday.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Well, please open your mouth.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: You have a cold. You need a good rest.

lines.speaker: Matsumoto
lines.text: Doctor, I have to go to Tokyo on business from tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Well then, take this medicine and go to bed early today.

lines.speaker: Matsumoto
lines.text: Yes, doctor.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: And do not take a bath tonight.

lines.speaker: Matsumoto
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Please take care.

lines.speaker: Matsumoto
lines.text: Thank you very much, doctor.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: What is your hobby, Mr. Santos?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Photography.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: What kind of photos do you take?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Photos of animals. I like those of horses, especially.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: Oh, that's interesting. Have you taken photos of horses since you came to Japan?

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: No. You can hardly ever see horses in Japan.

lines.speaker: Yamada
lines.text: There is a lot of pastureland for horses in Hokkaido.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Really? Then I would really like to go there on summer vacation.

19.title: As for my diet, I'll start it tomorrow

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Cheers!

lines.speaker: Ms. Matsumoto
lines.text: Why, Ms. Maria, you're not eating much.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: No. To tell the truth, I have been on a diet since yesterday.

lines.speaker: Ms. Matsumoto
lines.text: Have you? I have tried being on a diet many times, too.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: What kind of diets have you tried?

lines.speaker: Ms. Matsumoto
lines.text: I tried eating only apples, and drinking a lot of water, and so on.

lines.speaker: Mr. Matsumoto
lines.text: I'm afraid strict diets are not good for your health.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: You are right.

lines.speaker: Ms. Matsumoto
lines.text: Ms. Maria, this cake is delicious.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text: Is it? I'll start dieting again tomorrow.

20.title: What will you do for the summer vacation?

lines.speaker: Kobayashi
lines.text: Are you going home for the summer vacation?

lines.speaker: Thawaphon
lines.text: No, I won't. Though I want to.... What about you, Mr. Kobayashi?

lines.speaker: Kobayashi
lines.text: Well, what shall I do? Have you climbed Mt. Fuji, Mr. Thawaphon?

lines.speaker: Thawaphon
lines.text: No, I haven't.

lines.speaker: Kobayashi
lines.text: Then, if you'd like, shall we go together?

lines.speaker: Thawaphon
lines.text: Yes, okay. When?

lines.speaker: Kobayashi
lines.text: How about the beginning of August?

lines.speaker: Thawaphon
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Kobayashi
lines.text: Then, I will check up on various things and call you later.

lines.speaker: Thawaphon
lines.text: Thanks. I'll be waiting.
